title: Synthetic example: EUT matrix misses an inclusive approval threshold

expected.content: A request for exactly 500.00 USD must remain manager-approved and require finance approval.

actual.content: The EUT matrix covered below-threshold and above-threshold examples but skipped the inclusive 500.00 boundary.

lesson: When a requirement uses inclusive wording such as at or above, create an EUT for the exact boundary value, not only values on either side.
